intuition: If traversal enters a cycle, a faster pointer eventually laps a slower pointer.

brute_force.approach: Track visited node identities and return true when a node is visited twice.

optimal.approach: Advance slow by one link and fast by two; equality of node identity proves a cycle.

edge_cases: An empty list or a single node without a self-link has no cycle.
Compare node identity, not node values.
Check fast and fast.next before advancing two steps.
